title: 5 倒计时05
content_zh:
纵横交错的道路上车水马龙，闪烁的尾灯交织成网，承载着这个城市的繁忙。
游决今晚本来还要见一个客户，对方临时有事改了时间，他索性回了律所。
在这儿放了近一周，占地方不说，办公室里人来人往，大家虽没有直白地开口八卦，但总会投来揶揄好奇的目光。
一度想给它挪走，但这么大一幅画，不管叫不叫人帮忙，搬出办公室的那一刻，注定会引来更多的关注。
徐绍心当然知道游决的意思，她点点头：“让她想想吧，如果她要继续打官司，你要多尽心帮她。”
原本游决要和她一块儿去英国办个案子，打赢了，将会为他履历再添上漂亮的一笔。
但临时来了倪夏的事儿，不见得好处理。徐绍心自己又抽不出身，思来想去，最放心的还是游决。
但徐绍心深知自己不会是他一辈子的领导，他也未必会永远居于她之下。
手机震个不停，他坐到办公椅上，一边接听客户电话，一边打开微信。
方嘉林没回，工作信息堆积如山，他大致划了一眼，最后先打开了倪夏的对话框。
听到爷爷说出“五千万”时，她完全丧失了思考能力，恨不得像饿狼一样扑到游决身上。
搁置的项目，周期漫长的官司，还有一干等着最终结果的剧组人员……
她坐起身揉揉脸，才道：“刚到家。对了，今天我跟游决聊了咱们——”
米姐是场景地租赁负责人，这个时候找来，倪夏已经能预想到是什么事儿。
“我们租的场景不是春节就该到期了吗？”谷雨声说，“后续她肯定是要安排租给其他剧组的，所以来问我们电影预计什么时候开机。暂时开不了的话要不要续租，不然这景可就是其他组的了，到时候我们搭建的场景肯定保不住。”
“我知道，但现在的情况估摸至少要续两个月，这可不是一笔小钱。”
可是前段时间倪夏为了给剧组已经投入工作的员工结算工资，把自己能掏的钱全贴了进去，现在还能上哪儿找这九十万。
朋友们倒是能借给她钱，但是她自己都说不清什么时候能还上，又怎么好意思去借。
content_en:
The criss-crossing roads are busy with traffic, and the flashing taillights interweave into a network, carrying the busyness of the city.
You Jue was originally going to meet a client tonight, but the other party had something to do and changed the time, so he simply returned to the law firm.
It has been here for nearly a week. Not to mention the space it takes up, people come and go in the office. Although everyone does not openly gossip, they always cast a teasing and curious look.
I once wanted to move it, but for such a big painting, whether I ask for help or not, the moment I move it out of the office, it is bound to attract more attention.
Of course Xu Shaoxin knew what You Jue meant. She nodded: "Let her think about it. If she wants to continue the lawsuit, you should do your best to help her."
Originally, You Jie wanted to go to England with her to handle a case. If he won, it would be another beautiful addition to his resume.
But when the matter of Ni Xia suddenly came up, it might not be easy to handle. Xu Shaoxin couldn't escape. After thinking about it, the most relieved thing was You Jue.
But Xu Shaoxin knew that she would not be his lifelong leader, and he might not always be under her.
His phone kept vibrating. He sat on his office chair and opened WeChat while answering customer calls.
Fang Jialin didn't reply. There was a mountain of work information. He glanced at it briefly and finally opened Ni Xia's dialog box first.
When she heard her grandfather say "fifty million", she completely lost her ability to think and wanted to pounce on You Jue like a hungry wolf.
Shelved projects, lengthy lawsuits, and a crew waiting for the final result...
She sat up and rubbed her face before saying, "I just got home. By the way, I talked to You Jue today about us-"
Sister Mi is the person in charge of leasing the scene. When she came here, Ni Xia could already predict what was going on.
"Isn't the scene we rented due to expire during the Spring Festival?" Gu Yusheng said, "She will definitely arrange to rent it to other crews in the future, so she came to ask us when the movie is expected to start. If it cannot be launched temporarily, do we need to renew the lease? Otherwise, this scene will belong to other groups, and the scene we built will definitely not be preserved by then."
"I know, but the current situation estimates that it will last at least two months. This is not a small sum of money."
But some time ago, Ni Xia put in all the money he could in order to settle the wages of the crew who were already working. Where else could he find the 900,000 yuan now?
Friends could lend her money, but she couldn't tell when she would pay it back, and how could she have the nerve to borrow it.
